blocks.text: Solaire Resort recently held its first Suppliers’ Night at Solaire Resort Quezon City’s Grand Ballroom. The night celebrated valued business partners, their continued support and long-term contributions that helped drive the integrated resort’s success through more than a decade of collaborations. The event gathered valued local and international suppliers, executives, and team members to celebrate strong partnerships and shared achievements. The evening was spent recognizing the dedication of each person and team, shared achievements, and milestones, alongside a specially curated menu.
